stories.headline: Hot September PPI sends BTC under $80k for the first time in a month — then it's bought back
stories.blurb: Producer prices jumped 1.3% m/m and 6.3% y/y in September (core 5%), the second hot inflation report in two days. Bitcoin dipped to ~$79.7–79.8k, about $930M of crypto positions were liquidated (mostly longs), and price recovered to ~$82k within hours. — The $80k floor was tested and held on real buying — but a daily close below it would break the month-long range and flip the 7D view to Bear.

stories.headline: Bond rally pulls the dollar off its 18-month high; October hike odds cool to ~29%
stories.blurb: The 10-year Treasury yield fell back to ~5.09% from a 5.3%+ spike after CPI, as money left AI-heavy tech for bonds. Fed officials signalled they can wait, and CME FedWatch now shows ~29% odds of an Oct 27–28 hike, but ~88% for at least one hike by December. Chair Warsh speaks Friday in Bangkok. — Falling yields are what rescued crypto this week; a hawkish Warsh or another yield spike would remove that support quickly.

stories.headline: BTC ETFs lose $261M on Wednesday; Ether ETFs bleed $130M
stories.blurb: US spot bitcoin ETFs swung from a $176M inflow on Tuesday to a $261M outflow on Wednesday, led by Fidelity's FBTC and BlackRock's IBIT; Thursday was tracking a small outflow but was incomplete at this rebuild. The last five complete sessions are net −$374M. — The bounce rests on lower yields, not fresh demand — ETF flows need to turn positive for a run at $86k.

stories.headline: Futures flip from a leverage flush to a spot-led bounce
stories.blurb: CheckOnChain's futures OI vs price scatter moved from Deleveraging Sell-Off to Spot Rally as of Oct 15: seven-day open interest is slightly lower while price is slightly higher, and funding stays mildly positive. — A rebound without new leverage is healthier and harder to liquidate — but it also means no squeeze fuel to push through resistance quickly.

stories.headline: EU puts USDC under direct EBA oversight; Thailand's crypto ETF rules take effect
stories.blurb: The European Banking Authority classified Circle's USDC as the first 'significant' e-money token under MiCA, with direct EBA supervision of reserves, liquidity and redemption plans from Nov 12. Thailand's SEC framework for BTC/ETH ETFs (80% minimum exposure, licensed custody, no margin) took effect Oct 16. — Regulated rails keep widening for stablecoins and ETFs — slow-burn structural demand rather than a near-term price driver.
